name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engines. Growing up near the old Kallang Circuit, he'd spend hours listening to the roaring engines and dreaming of being involved. He started his career as an apprentice in a local engineering workshop, quickly mastering the fundamentals of machining and metalwork. His talent and dedication led him to opportunities within Singapore's small but growing racing scene.

He joined Prema Racing five years ago, bringing with him a wealth of experience in precision engineering. Tan is known for his meticulous approach, ensuring every component he works on meets the highest standards. His innovative solutions to complex machining problems have earned him the respect of his colleagues, and his ambition drives him to constantly improve his skills and contribute to the team's success. He is a key figure in the team's engine development and reliability.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his tools before starting any task, regardless of whether they need it.
Keeps a small collection of antique tools in his locker.
Hums quietly while working on intricate parts.
